                     ==>
192                end

                     ==>

                   ==>

                     -7-

                       ==>

                              -8-  
                     ==>
                     MISSING_ELSE
                     ==>
202                  if (w_hs && m_wlast) begin m_st <= M_IDLE; wv <= 1'b0; end
                     -9-  
                     ==>
                     MISSING_ELSE
                     ==>
203                end
